description: Spec 006 D2: the baseline's tasks and their knobs. A knob sets up a state the live daemon makes hard to reach, after the warm-up and before the session. daemon "stopped": the daemon is stopped and cannot be started again (SQUEAL_CLI names no file), so no daemon validates. staleEdit: the daemon is stopped, the file is edited outside the session, and the session starts with results from the older revision. flakeColdRuns: the flaky calendar test stays cold for that many runs after each change to src/clock.ts, so it also fails Squeal's first re-run.
